delivery.rap: A vocal performance with rhythmic rapping, quick syllables and a spoken hip hop flow.
delivery.melodic_rap: A melodic rap vocal with Auto-Tuned singing, flowing rhythmic phrases and trap delivery.
delivery.soulful_singing: An expressive soulful sung vocal with sustained notes, powerful phrasing and emotional intensity.
delivery.gentle_singing: A soft intimate sung vocal with gentle sustained melodies and restrained delivery.

themes.heartbreak: The singer expresses heartbreak, betrayal, loss and anger about a broken relationship.
themes.romance: The singer expresses romantic love, attraction, longing and intimacy.
themes.confidence: The rapper boasts about confidence, success, money, fashion and status.
themes.celebration: The lyrics express partying, dancing, celebration and having a good time.
themes.struggle: The lyrics express struggle, adversity, survival and determination.
themes.reflection: The lyrics express personal reflection, memories, sadness and vulnerability.
